purpose: Make the engineering decision filter mandatory at every node/change without redefining the existing numeric category map in a second truth source.

category_authority.rule: Category IDs/names shall be read from the existing mapper/source when available. This policy does not renumber them.

decision_rule: Every applicable domain must be PASS, HOLD, OPEN or N/A with explicit rationale/evidence.
A screening PASS may authorize only the maturity claim it actually proves.
Engineering-baseline promotion may preserve release-only HOLDs when the change itself is geometrically/semantically verified and those HOLDs remain explicit.
Product/R01 release requires zero unresolved applicable release blockers.
Material state must be explicit for every affected part; unknown material is OPEN, never inferred.
Rejected alternatives and reasons remain in change/decision history.
step_gate: No mutating engineering step may bypass checkpoint/authority/dependency/technical-filter review.
